analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 35.2 entering oversold territory, MACD histogram at -0.6701 continuing to worsen. Five consecutive negative closes, but the 5-day low of $164.16 did not breach the 20-day low of $162.14, limiting downside support breach. However, the 5-day high of $176.49 fell below the 20-day high of $191.55, continuing the bearish pattern. Weekly ADX at 33.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (37.3) is stronger than +DI (16.6), confirming a bearish trend. Current price of $164.76 is near the lower Bollinger Band of $160.07, suggesting potential for a bounce, but strong bearish trend signals make a bullish shift premature.
